items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: Oh when Zooty worked there? See the, I believe Mutt Carey was there at the time. I played with Mutt Carey.

ctx.x: Well they didn't read the music. But they could play it. They could play though.

They had good ear. Yeah. Oh I didn't get down about that E-line. Oh when Zooty worked there? Let's see the, I believe, probably Mutt Carey was there. I played with Mutt Carey. I played with Mutt Carey. Mutt Carey. Mutt Carey had a way to take him to play. He was a part of the music. He was a part of the music.
Well they didn't read the music. But they could play it.
